# Code of conduct

DistTrainer expects professional, technically rigorous, and respectful
collaboration in issues, reviews, discussions, and private project channels.

Participants must not harass, threaten, demean, or discriminate against
others; publish another person's private information; disclose credentials or
security reports in public; or deliberately disrupt project infrastructure.
Technical disagreement should address evidence, contracts, and trade-offs
rather than people.

Report conduct concerns privately to the copyright holder through the contact
listed in the [security policy](SECURITY.md). The maintainer may edit or remove
content, restrict participation, or reject contributions to protect people and
the project. Reports are handled as confidentially as practical; retaliation
against a good-faith reporter is not accepted.
